verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Statsig serves an llms.txt at docs.statsig.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) describing its official documentation. Statsig also documents a Docs MCP server that lets AI clients read public documentation directly from /api/mcp with no API key, so agents can consume the docs directly. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of how well agents use these docs, and evidence of how deep the llms.txt coverage goes (e.g., a full-content variant or per-page markdown).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.statsig.com/llms.txt # Statsig Documentation
Use the Statsig Docs MCP server to let supported AI clients read public Statsig documentation directly from /api/mcp.
The Docs MCP server reads documentation only and needs no API key.
